### 0. Configure environment. Load data.
```{r config, show=F, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("analysis/0-config.R"))

############################
# CSPS surveillance data
# encounter level
############################
visit_01A_filtered <- 
  readRDS(paste0(temp_data_path,"visit_01A_filtered.Rds"))


############################
# ACLED event data
############################
events_01B_long <- 
  readRDS(paste0(temp_data_path,"events_01B_long.Rds"))


############################
# File 01B data
############################
df_all <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_all.rds"))
df_mal <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_mal.rds"))
df_pne <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_pne.rds"))
df_dia <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_dia.rds"))

```

### 1B. Summary statistics -- exposures
- Total events
- Total local/distant events
- Total violent/non-violent events

```{r}

events_04_temp <-
  events_01B_long %>%
  group_by(csps) %>%
  summarise(
    # Binary indicators by violence type and proximity
    event_any_loc = ifelse(any(is_loc), as.integer(1), as.integer(2)),
    event_any_vio = ifelse(any(is_vio), as.integer(1), as.integer(2)),
    # event_any_loc_vio = (is_loc * is_vio),
    
    # Count indicators by violence type and proximity
    # event_tot_fat = as.integer(sum(fatalities, na.rm = T)),
    event_tot_loc = sum(is_loc==1, na.rm = T),
    event_tot_dist = sum(is_loc==0, na.rm = T),
    event_tot_vio = sum(is_vio==1, na.rm = T),
    event_tot_nonvio = sum(is_vio==0, na.rm = T),
    # event_tot_loc_vio = sum(event_any_loc_vio, na.rm = T),
    event_min_dist = min(dist_km, na.rm = T),
    event_max_dist = max(dist_km, na.rm = T),
    event_med_dist = median(dist_km, na.rm = T)
    ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    median_loc = median(event_tot_loc, na.rm=T),
    iqr_loc = IQR(event_tot_loc, na.rm=T),
    median_dist = median(event_tot_dist, na.rm=T),
    iqr_dist = IQR(event_tot_dist, na.rm=T),

    median_vio = median(event_tot_vio, na.rm=T),
    iqr_vio = IQR(event_tot_vio, na.rm=T),
    median_nonvio = median(event_tot_nonvio, na.rm=T),
    iqr_nonvio = IQR(event_tot_nonvio, na.rm=T),

    median_distance = median(event_med_dist, na.rm = T),
    iqr_distance = IQR(event_med_dist, na.rm = T)
  )

events_04_temp

as.data.frame(
  table(events_01B_long$csps,
      events_01B_long$is_loc)
) %>%
  group_by(Var2) %>%
  summarise(median = median(Freq))
  
table(events_01B_long$is_loc)
1188/7348 #local
6160/7348 #distant

length(unique(events_01B_long$id_event))
167*44

1188/44

27/167
```
